name: The Scale Shore
description: Trackways in the stone, going into the sea.
arrival: Three-toed prints in the black rock, a stride and a half apart, walking in a straight line toward water that was not there when they were made. They do not come back.
notes: The other half of the split, in the same stone as the Fang Bed and a short walk from it. Two kinds of animal that canon says never shared ground, lying in one rock -- which is the whole argument the map makes and never states.
